scope: Source-only common Git Work and repository ownership workflow. No native activation or external feature implementation.

transportOwner.meaning: Checks exact provider checkout identity and dispatches the existing canonical CLI; never interprets or forks common Work validation. Rechecks provider identity after the child exits. This source check is not an immutable native execution boundary.

preparation.worktreeMode: Separate Git branches/worktrees can share Git object storage. Existing checkouts and historical branches are preserved.
dependencies: Use each owner frozen lock and ignore install scripts.
Install only dependencies needed by the selected serial source check.
The common reader uses its own pinned provider checkout and dependencies; no automatic update to historical module Artifact/WorkContext locks.
preparation.source: Canonical validation reads committed Git objects. Dirty bytes must be committed on their owning branch before qualification.

steps.action: Select the exact repositoryId/commit and qualified domain/project/work/task. Same bare workId under different projects is not one global Work.

steps.interpretation: The canonical reader validates common records and actual answer/source bindings.
Preserve source currentness: unknown/unavailable is a dependent hold, never silently current.

The canonical context includes source pointers, not copies of original answers. Resolve pathBase against the selected Work/repository, then read the exact original through the canonical source reader before a consequential decision. Never infer the original answer from a paraphrase.
Print source-backed ownership and existing check routes without dispatching them. Select owner commands explicitly, one at a time.
Run the canonical semantic transition check before integrating source changes. Never infer review, publication, native use or acceptance from source qualification.

placeholders.PINNED_AGENT_PLATFORM_ROOT: Explicit clean provider worktree at the exact commit above
placeholders.SNAPSHOT_JSON: A bounded file containing the caller-selected exact Git Work selection
placeholders.CONTEXT_REQUEST_JSON: A bounded file with snapshot and context; maxChars <=24000 and explicit latestRelevant
placeholders.REPOSITORY_RELATIVE_SOURCE_PATH: Exact repository-relative path resolved from the canonical context source receipt; keep snapshot identity/commit and source fragment interpretation unchanged.

heldEffects: MCP and month-end feature implementation is other-owner PR scope.
Old WorkLeads, frontend/Bot Screen, real student data, Jev inference and old ledgers remain held.
No automatic repository retirement, native/data cutover, runtime configuration, deployment, publication or merge.
